sentences.ko: 말씀하신 방향은 이해가 되는데, 지금 인력으로 그 일정을 맞추려다 보면 결국 품질에서 손해를 볼 것 같다는 게 제 걱정입니다.
sentences.text: I see where you are coming from, but my concern is that if we try to hit that deadline with the people we have, we will end up paying for it in quality.
alts: I understand your point, but I worry that pushing for that timeline with our current headcount would cost us on quality in the end.
That makes sense in principle, though I am afraid that if we commit to that date with this team, quality is what will suffer.
sentences.note: 정중한 반대는 상대 말을 먼저 인정하고(I see where you are coming from) 걱정으로 돌려 말합니다. end up -ing 은 '결국 ~하게 되다'.

sentences.ko: 두 달쯤 전부터 아침에 일어날 때 오른쪽 어깨가 뻣뻣한데, 낮에 움직이다 보면 좀 풀리다가 밤이 되면 다시 아파집니다.
sentences.text: For about two months now, my right shoulder has been stiff when I wake up, and although it loosens as I move around during the day, the pain comes back at night.
alts: My right shoulder has been stiff first thing in the morning for a couple of months, and it eases up as I move but hurts again at night.
For the past two months I have woken up with a stiff right shoulder that loosens during the day, only to start aching again once evening comes.
sentences.note: 증상은 '언제부터(for ~), 언제 심한지(when I wake up), 무엇으로 나아지는지(as I move)' 순서로 말하면 알아듣기 쉽습니다. loosen up = 뻣뻣한 것이 풀리다.

sentences.ko: 이미 두 번이나 같은 문제로 연락을 드렸는데도 고쳐지지 않았으니, 이번에는 수리 일정만 잡아 주실 게 아니라 그동안 못 쓴 기간에 대한 보상도 해 주셨으면 합니다.
sentences.text: Since I have already called twice about the same problem and nothing has been fixed, I would like more than another repair appointment and some compensation for the lost time.
alts: Given that I have reported this twice with no fix, scheduling another repair is not enough, and I would also like to be compensated for the time it was unusable.
This is the third time I am raising the same issue, so on top of the repair I would expect some compensation for the period I was left without it.
sentences.note: 화내지 않고 세게 말하는 법: 사실(두 번 연락) → 그래서 부족하다(do more than) → 요구(compensate). do more than ~ 은 '~만으로는 안 된다'.
sentences.situation: 서비스가 잘못됐을 때 항의하고 보상 요구하기

sentences.ko: 가격을 그 정도까지 맞춰 드릴 수는 있는데, 그러려면 물량을 지금 말씀하신 것의 두 배로 잡아 주시고 대금은 선불로 주셔야 합니다.
sentences.text: I could bring the price down to that level, but only if you double the volume you just mentioned and pay for the whole order up front.
alts: That price is possible on the condition that you take twice the quantity you mentioned and settle the full amount in advance.
I would be willing to go down to that figure, provided that you commit to double the order and pay everything up front.
sentences.note: 조건을 거는 협상은 but only if / on the condition that / provided that 로 붙입니다. up front = 선불로.

sentences.ko: 그때 제가 답을 늦게 드린 게 무시한 걸로 보였다면 정말 죄송한데, 사실은 확인할 게 남아 있어서 확실해질 때까지 기다렸던 겁니다.
sentences.text: If my slow reply came across as me ignoring you, I am genuinely sorry, because the truth is that I was waiting until I had something certain to tell you.
alts: I am sorry if taking so long to get back to you felt dismissive, but I was holding off until I actually had a clear answer.
If my delay looked like I was brushing you off, that was not my intention at all, and I simply wanted to wait until I knew for sure.
sentences.note: come across as ~ 는 '~처럼 보이다'. 해명은 사과를 먼저 하고 이유는 the truth is 로 뒤에 붙이는 것이 부드럽습니다.
sentences.situation: 오해가 생겼을 때 해명하고 관계를 수습하기
